budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Deliver the three finite cargo boats to basin 3 while irrigating each indexed crop twice or recording its loss. Each role benefits especially from its same-index cargo and crop; sharing and bridge access affect all roles.
task.natural_termination: All three boats delivered and every crop either has two doses or zero health. Otherwise the horizon is 160 live transitions. A dead crop remains an explicit negative outcome.
task.interaction: A gate simultaneously controls a walking bridge, one conserved delayed water packet, and boat passage. Irrigation and emergency drainage remove water needed for later downstream cargo. Close votes veto opens. Shared crop and spill allocations rotate by t modulo three.
task.observation_access: Fully observable. Each role receives its identity and the complete public dynamic state and tile layout. Fixed active/visibility arrays are public constants; boat activity is exactly the complement of the observed delivered flag. Static entity positions are included or directly determined by observed node identity.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Crop received at least one dose this turn
Cargo first arrived at port this turn
Unfinished crop lost one health this turn
Units intentionally drained from each basin this turn

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
